literal: When battle occurs, life not-fearing warriors, their king even if angry, glory diminishing they do not have.
translation: Warriors who do not fear for their lives when battle comes will not lose their dignity, even if their king rages against them.
modern: போர் வரும்போது தம் உயிர்க்கு அஞ்சாத வீரர்கள், தம் அரசன் கோபித்துக் கொண்டாலும், தம்முடைய பெருமை குறையப் பெற மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme self-respect and dignity of brave warriors. When battle arrives (உறின்), these soldiers do not fear for their lives (உயிர் அஞ்சா). Their sense of honor is so steadfast that even if their own king or commander becomes angry with them (செறினும்), they will never let their dignity or glory (சீர்) diminish (குன்றல் இலர்). The poet shows that true valor is independent and remains unshaken even by the wrath of one's own ruler.
